# Voyager Maps

> A free travel map of the practical places most maps leave out: public toilets, free drinking water, showers, laundromats, Wi-Fi, parking and campervan services. 5.5 million locations across 237 countries and territories, from OpenStreetMap, available on the web, iOS and Android in 13 languages.

Voyager Maps answers one kind of question: *where is the nearest useful thing right now* — a restroom, a place to refill a bottle, a shower, a laundromat, somewhere to park a van overnight. General map services index businesses and directions; these categories are patchy there because they are rarely anyone's commercial listing. This site publishes them as counted, categorised data instead.

Last updated: 2026-09-09.

## Coverage

Figures as published on the site. Counts are of mapped locations, not of every location that exists.

- Locations: 5.5 million
- Countries and territories: 237
- With free Wi-Fi: 389,000
- Largest categories: parking, fuel stations, public toilets, supermarkets, pharmacies, drinking water
- Per-location attributes where the source records them: fee, wheelchair access, opening hours, seasonal availability, payment methods, operator website and phone

## Data source and licence

- Place data comes from [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/) contributors and is licensed under the [Open Database License (ODbL)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/).
- Attribution required when reusing this data: "© OpenStreetMap contributors".
- Counts, category groupings and per-city or per-country aggregates published on this site are derived works over that data. They may be quoted with attribution to Voyager Maps and to OpenStreetMap contributors.
- Coverage reflects what volunteers have mapped. It is denser in Europe and North America than elsewhere, and absence from the map is not evidence that a place does not exist.

## Maps by category

- [Voyager Maps home](https://getvoyagermaps.com/): what the app does, how it compares to general map services, and the full category list.
- [Public toilet map](https://getvoyagermaps.com/public-toilet-map.html): finding restrooms while travelling, including which are free, paid, or customer-only.
- [Drinking water map](https://getvoyagermaps.com/drinking-water-map.html): free public taps, fountains and bottle refill points.
- [Free shower map](https://getvoyagermaps.com/free-shower-map.html): showers at campsites, beaches, marinas and service stations.
- [Parking map](https://getvoyagermaps.com/parking-map.html): parking including height limits, fees and overnight suitability.
- [Campervan service map](https://getvoyagermaps.com/campervan-service-map.html): fresh water, grey water disposal, chemical toilet disposal and electric hookup.
- [Backpacker map](https://getvoyagermaps.com/backpacker-map.html): hostels, stations, luggage lockers and city stopover essentials.

## Apps

- [iOS on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/6758412494): free, no subscription, no in-app purchases.
- [Android on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voyagermap.voyagermobil.voyagermobil): free, no subscription, no in-app purchases.

## Languages

Every page above exists in 13 languages. English is at the site root; each other language lives under its own path prefix, and the pages carry a full hreflang set.

- Path prefixes: `/de/` `/fr/` `/es/` `/it/` `/pt/` `/nl/` `/pl/` `/hu/` `/ja/` `/zh/` `/ko/` `/hi/`
- Example: the drinking water map in German is at https://getvoyagermaps.com/de/drinking-water-map.html
